scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --names "AI,Backend,Frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,yellow.bold,magenta.bold" --restart-tries 3 "npm run ai" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.ai: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'ai_service/app.py') { .venv\Scripts\python.exe ai_service/app.py } else { Write-Host 'AI service folder is not present yet - waiting for model attachment.' }"
scripts.kill:ports: powershell -Command "@(5000,5173,8000) | ForEach-Object { $port=$_; $r=netstat -ano | Select-String \":$port .*LISTEN\"; if($r){ $r | ForEach-Object { $pidNum=($_ -split '\s+')[-1].Trim(); if($pidNum -match '^\d+$'){ taskkill /F /PID $pidNum } } } }"
scripts.restart:full: npm run kill:ports && npm run dev:full
